\section[novus, nova, novum]{novus, nova, novum — new}

\label{lesson:LA-C94-novus}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: novus, nova, novum}
\textbf{novus, nova, novum} — \textquotedblleft{}new\textquotedblright{}. English \emph{novel}.
